scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Hm? You're... What is it about you? I've been an honorable Knight for a long time, but I cannot understand this feeling I'm getting from you...
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
嗯？你是……你身上有什么特别之处吗？我作为一名光荣的骑士已经很久了，但我无法理解我从你身上感受到的这种感觉……

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, a member of our Chivalry.
I hope you are living up to my expectations. We have vowed to be strong for our kingdom, even if death is upon us...
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊，你是我们骑士团的一员。
我希望你能不负我的期望。我们曾发誓，即使面对死亡，也要为了王国而坚强……

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome,
this is the
Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
欢迎，这里是普隆德拉骑士团。
请问有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome. We, the proud Knights of the Prontera Chivalry, will give our lives for king and country! Please enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
欢迎。我们，普隆德拉骑士团骄傲的骑士们，愿为国王和国家献出生命！请尽情享用您的停留。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome, this is
the Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
欢迎，这里是普隆德拉骑士团。
请问有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Mmm?
{0},
what can I do for you?
Ah, you don't know
who to visit?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
嗯？
{0}，
有什么可以帮你的吗？
啊，你不知道该找谁吗？

scripts.text: [Captain Herman]
scripts.translation: [船长 赫尔曼]

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Finish the last test.
Once that is complete, all the Knights involved in your testing shall gather, and we will evaluate your performance.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
完成最后一项测试。
一旦完成，所有参与你测试的骑士将会聚集在一起，我们将评估你的表现。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return once you have distributed all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
哦……！
如果你还有未分配的技能点，就不能转职。请在分配完所有技能点后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh, have you completed all the tests? But not everyone who completes the tests can
become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
哦，你已经完成了所有测试吗？但并非所有完成测试的人都能成为骑士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
May god bless your body and soul, warrior. I hope you will show your courage and protect those who are weaker than you.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
愿上帝保佑你的身体和灵魂，战士。我希望你能展现你的勇气，保护那些比你更弱的人。

scripts.text: I want to change my job to Swordman.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为剑士。

scripts.text: I want to change my job to a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为骑士。

scripts.text: Just visiting.
scripts.translation: 只是来看看。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
A-ha~
A Swordman, you say?
I'm sorry, {0}, but you've
come to the wrong place!
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊哈~
你说你是剑士？
抱歉，{0}，你走错地方了！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
This isn't the Swordsman guild, it's the Prontera Chivalry! If you wish to become a Swordman, visit the Swordman Guild located in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
这里不是剑士公会，而是普隆德拉骑士团！如果你想成为剑士，请去依斯鲁得岛的剑士公会。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, I see that you have great ambition. But you must first become a Swordman before becoming
a Knight. One step at a time...
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊，看来你很有雄心壮志。但在成为骑士之前，你必须先成为剑士。一步一步来……

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First, visit the Swordman guild in Izlude. Then, come visit us again once you have become a well experienced Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
首先，去依斯鲁得岛的剑士公会。然后，当你成为一名经验丰富的剑士后，再来拜访我们。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Aha~
You must have lots of free time. Why don't you go hunt some monsters instead of wandering about aimlessly?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊哈~
你一定有很多空闲时间。与其漫无目的地闲逛，不如去猎杀一些魔物吧？

scripts.text:
Welcome, this is
the Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
欢迎，这里是普隆德拉骑士团。
请问有什么事吗？

scripts.text: I want to change my job to a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为骑士。

scripts.text: Just visiting.
scripts.translation: 只是来看看。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ohh...
A young {0} who wishes
to become a Knight!
Our Prontera Chivalry
will assist you.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
噢...
想要成为骑士的年轻{0}！
普隆德拉骑士团将协助您。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First of all, I am the captain of the Prontera Chivalry, Herman Phon Efesirsus. I'm pleased to meet young people eager to join the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
首先，我是普隆德拉骑士团的船长，赫尔曼·冯·艾菲西斯。很高兴见到渴望加入普隆德拉骑士团的年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
We only accept Swordmen
who are at least Job Level 40.
We cannot consider applicants that are not yet experienced enough to become Knights.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
我们只接受职业等级至少为40的剑士。
我们无法考虑经验尚不足以成为骑士的申请者。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Once you apply, and we find
you eligible, we will begin the job change procedure. Would you
like to apply now?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
一旦您提出申请，且我们确认您符合条件，我们将开始转职程序。
您现在想要申请吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I would like to apply.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想申请。

scripts.text: I'd like to think about it please.
scripts.translation: 请让我再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, you are not yet ready to become a Knight! Didn't I specifically mention the Job Level 40 requirement?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊，您还尚未准备好成为骑士！我不是特别提到了职业等级40的要求吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return when you have used
all of your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊...！
如果您还有未使用的技能点，就无法转职。请在用完所有技能点后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Let me see...
Your name is
{0}...
Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
让我看看...
您的名字是
{0}...
对吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Of course I understand your strong desire to join us, but now is not the time. Go out and fight some more monsters. We will be here waiting.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
我当然理解您想要加入我们强烈的愿望，但现在还不是时候。出去多打些魔物吧。我们会在这里等待。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Let me explain the job change procedure. You must visit a series of Knights and pass each
of their tests.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
让我解释一下转职程序。您必须拜访一系列骑士，并通过他们各自的测试。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Once all the tests are completed, every Knight involved in your testing will gather and discuss your performance.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
当所有测试完成后，参与您测试的所有骑士将聚集在一起讨论您的表现。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
The Knights must unanimously approve of you before you can join the Prontera Chivalry. If only one person objects, you must
start over.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
骑士们必须一致同意您才能加入普隆德拉骑士团。如果有一人反对，您就必须重新开始。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
But I believe if you persist with an earnest heart, you shall be acknowledged by the Knights and ultimately recognized as a member of our Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
但我相信，如果您怀着真诚的心坚持到底，您将会被骑士们认可，并最终被承认为我们骑士团的一员。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
So, let's not waste any more time talking! Go and meet these Knights and begin their tests. Once you have completed all of the tests, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
所以，让我们不要再浪费时间谈话了！去见见这些骑士，开始他们的测试吧。完成所有测试后，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...!
Well, I don't want to pressure you. Take your time and think it over. Return when you are ready to
change jobs, for we will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
噢...！
嗯，我不想给您压力。请慢慢考虑。当您准备好转职时再回来，因为我们会在这里等待。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Come to think of it, aren't you a Swordman? It looks like you've encountered many foes in battle.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
说起来，您不是剑士吗？看起来您在战斗中遇到过很多敌人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
You should consider changing jobs to a Knight. Come and talk to me if you are interested.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
您应该考虑转职为骑士。如果您有兴趣，就来和我谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Please take
your time in
looking around.
Good day.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
请慢慢
四处看看。
祝您愉快。

scripts.text:
Mmm?
{0},
what can I do for you?
Ah, you don't know
who to visit?
scripts.translation:
嗯？
{0}，
有什么可以帮您的吗？
啊，您不知道
该去见谁吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I believe the Knights in charge of testing have set an order in which you must visit them. I suppose it helps the testing process.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
负责考核的骑士们已经安排好了您必须拜访的顺序。我想这对考核流程很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First, go and visit
Sir Andrew for your first test. Don't be too nervous, he'll explain everything once you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
首先，去拜访安德鲁爵士进行第一项考核。别太紧张，和他对话后他会解释一切的。

scripts.text: It appears that you have finished one test. Let's see. Sir Andrew, who must this Swordman visit next?
scripts.translation: 看来你已经完成了一项考核。让我看看。安德鲁爵士，这位剑士接下来应该去见谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
I said to
visit Sir Siracuse.
Funny, I thought I told
you. Did I forget...?
scripts.translation:
[安德鲁爵士]
我说的是
去见西拉库斯爵士。
奇怪，我以为我告诉过你。
是我忘了吗...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Did you hear?
Go to Sir Siracuse and take his test. Once you complete his test, do not forget who you're supposed to visit next as well.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
你听到了吗？
去见西拉库斯爵士并接受他的考核。完成他的考核后，别忘了接下来该去见谁。

scripts.text:
Let's see...
You've completed two tests.
Sir Siracuse, who must this Swordman visit next?
scripts.translation:
让我看看...
你已经完成了两项考核。
西拉库斯爵士，这位剑士接下来应该去见谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Oh...!
Um, who was next...?
Right! Sir Windsor!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
噢...！
嗯，下一个是谁来着...？
对了！温莎爵士！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Head over to
Sir Windsor Benedict for your next test. Listen carefully to the Knights in charge of testing so that you don't feel lost, alright?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
去温莎·本尼迪克特爵士那里接受下一项考核。仔细听负责考核的骑士们说的话，这样你就不会迷失方向了，好吗？

scripts.text:
Sir Windor...?
Who must this
Swordman visit
next?
scripts.translation:
温莎爵士...？
这位剑士
接下来应该
去见谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
...Amy Beatrice.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...艾米·贝阿特丽丝。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, go and visit
Lady Amy and take her test. Make sure you pay attention to who you must go to for your next test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
啊，去见艾米夫人并接受她的考核。务必留意接下来该去见谁。

scripts.text:
Let's see...
Lady Amy, who
must this Swordman
visit next?
scripts.translation:
让我看看...
艾米夫人，这位
剑士接下来
应该去见谁？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh...
I said to visit
Sir Edmond!
Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
噢...
我说的是去见
埃德蒙爵士！
嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Now, go and speak
to Sir Edmond. He will
be in charge of your
next test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
现在，去和埃德蒙爵士对话。他将负责你的下一项考核。

scripts.text:
Don't you only have to visit one more person? The Knight in
charge of the final test
is Sir Gray Prospheiro.
scripts.translation: 你只需要再拜访一个人吧？负责最终考核的骑士是格雷·普罗斯佩罗爵士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
This world operates according
to the law of cause and effect.
All will be revealed in the end.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
这个世界遵循因果法则。
一切终将水落石出。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Be alert and do
your best, as this
is the last test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
保持警惕并全力以赴，
因为这是最后一项考核。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Return to me
after you have
completed the
final test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
完成最终考核后
回来找我。

scripts.text:
Finish the last test.
Once that is complete, all the Knights involved in your testing shall gather, and we will evaluate your performance.
scripts.translation:
完成最后一项考核。
完成后，所有参与考核的骑士将齐聚一堂，共同评估你的表现。

scripts.text:
Oh...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return once you have distributed all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
哦...！
如果还有未分配的技能点，则无法更换职业。
请在分配完所有技能点后再回来。

scripts.text:
Oh, have you completed all the tests? But not everyone who completes the tests can
become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
哦，你已经完成了所有考核吗？
但并非所有完成考核的人都能成为骑士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
During the test we see how loyal, honorable and strong you are. We also see if you were courteous and if you know the value of modesty and reverence.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
在考核中，我们会观察你的忠诚、荣誉和力量。
我们也会观察你是否彬彬有礼，是否懂得谦逊与敬畏的价值。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Through this process, I have also observed your actions. All seven of our opinions will be reflected in the decision of your job change.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
在这个过程中，我也观察了你的言行。
我们七人的意见都将反映在你更换职业的判定中。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Then...
We shall listen
to everyone's thoughts!
Andrew, what do you think?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
那么...
我们来听听大家的意见吧！
安德鲁爵士，您怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
What can I say?
I approve!
Having lived as
a Swordsman up
until now
is enough.
scripts.translation:
[安德鲁爵士]
我能说什么呢？
我赞成！
一直作为剑士生活到现在，
已经足够了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
This one has
gathered items
that are troublesome
to obtain. I approve!
I believe {0}he will continue to be loyal after becoming a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[安德鲁爵士]
这位收集到了
许多难以获得的物品。
我对此表示认可！
我相信{0}在成为骑士之后，
依然会保持忠诚。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Hmm.
What a nice review.
Siracuse, what are your thoughts?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
嗯。
真是不错的评价。
西拉库斯爵士，您怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Heh, very well. Not quite what
I would want, but hopefully will become better in the future.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
呵，很好。虽然不完全符合我的期望，
但希望未来会变得更好。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
After becoming a Knight, you must build a good reputation through honor. Ehh... I approve.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
成为骑士后，你必须通过荣誉建立良好的名声。嗯...我赞成。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Okay...
Windsor,
what about you?
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
好的...
温莎爵士，
您怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
....Approved.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
....通过。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I don't think
he disapproves.
Then, let's listen
to Amy's opinion.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
我觉得他并不反对。
那么，我们来听听艾米夫人的意见。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~ He's so polite!
He'll grow to be a wonderful Knight. And he's got such cute widdle cheeeeks~ Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯~他真有礼貌！
他一定会成长为一名出色的骑士。而且他的脸颊好可爱~呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~ She should be great!
She's very courteous and also very cute, so a few more points! Heh~
I shouldn't be saying things like this!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯~她一定很棒！
她非常有礼貌，而且非常可爱，所以多加几分！呵~
我不该说这种话的！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Well...
A strange review,
but I believe
she approves.
Edmond, speak
your mind.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
嗯...
虽然评价有些奇怪，
但我相信她是赞成的。
埃德蒙爵士，请说出您的看法。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
He seems a little rough, but something bright shines within him. With polish and refinement, his true value will shine forth
as the sun.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
他看起来有些粗鲁，但内心闪烁着光芒。经过磨练与修养，他的真正价值将如太阳般闪耀。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
It's difficult to see, but there is a spiritual beauty within her. With polish and refinement, her true value will glow as resplendently
as the moon.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
虽然难以察觉，但她内心有着精神之美。经过磨练与修养，她的真正价值将如月亮般光辉灿烂。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Lastly...
Gray. I would like
to hear your thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
最后...
格雷。我想听听您的看法。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
A young {0} coming here with the determination to become a Knight is enough...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
一位年轻的{0}，怀着成为骑士的决心来到这里，这就足够了...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Everyone
has approved.
No one has opposed.
Then I shall tell
you my opinion.
scripts.translation:
[船长 赫尔曼]
大家都表示赞同。
没有人反对。

在申请转职之前，你应该更多地了解骑士这个职业！

[Sir Siracuse]
Knights can also use Spears, unlike other jobs, and have skills related to Spears as well. What skills are not necessary to learn the skill Brandish Spear?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
与其他职业不同，骑士也可以使用长矛，并且拥有与长矛相关的技能。
学习“骑乘攻击”不需要以下哪个技能？

scripts.text: Pierce Lv.5
scripts.translation: 连刺攻击 Lv.5

scripts.text: Spear Stab Lv.3
scripts.translation: 长矛刺击 Lv.3

scripts.text: Spear Boomerang Lv.3
scripts.translation: 投掷长矛攻击 Lv.3

scripts.text: Peco Peco Ride Lv.1
scripts.translation: 骑乘术 Lv.1

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong! You need to learn that to learn Brandish Spear! How can you not know about Knights if you want to become one?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
错了！学习“骑乘攻击”需要学习这个技能！
如果你想成为骑士，怎么能不了解骑士呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
If you aren't sure about anything, go into town and ask any Knight
for help. Come back after you've learned more about Knights.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
如果你对任何事都不确定，就去城里找任何一位骑士寻求帮助。
在更多地了解骑士之后，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Some Spears also have magical attributes, just like spells. Of the following, which can attack a Nightmare, which has the Ghost attribute?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
有些长矛像法术一样拥有魔法属性。
在以下选项中，哪把长矛可以攻击拥有幽灵属性的梦魇？

scripts.text: Zephyrus
scripts.translation: 西风长矛

scripts.text: Lance
scripts.translation: 长枪

scripts.text: Bill Guisarme
scripts.translation: 修尔特长矛

scripts.text: Crescent Scythe
scripts.translation: 死神之镰

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong! You'll be doing absolutely no damage with that type of Spear! Come back after you've learned more about Knights!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
错了！使用那种长矛完全无法造成伤害！
在更多地了解骑士之后，再回来吧！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
If you have a question, just ask any Knight in town. This is basic knowledge for us!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
如果你有问题，直接去城里问任何一位骑士。
这对我们来说是基础知识！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
When you become a Knight you can ride a Peco Peco. However, your attack speed decreases once you're mounted on a Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
当你成为骑士后，你可以骑乘大嘴鸟。
但是，一旦骑上大嘴鸟，你的攻击速度会降低。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
But, you can counter this speed decrease as you learn the Cavalier Mastery skill. What percentage of your normal attack speed will you have after learning Level 3 Cavalier Mastery?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
不过，随着你学习“骑兵修炼”技能，可以抵消这种速度降低。
学习3级“骑兵修炼”后，你将拥有正常攻击速度的百分之多少？

scripts.text: 70 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的70%

scripts.text: 80 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的80%

scripts.text: 90 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的90%

scripts.text: 100 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的100%

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong!
Don't bother riding a Peco Peco if you don't know about Cavalier Mastery!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
错了！
如果你不了解“骑兵修炼”，就别骑大嘴鸟了！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You better come back after you've learned a little more about Knights!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你最好回去多了解一些关于骑士的知识，然后再来！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Good, good...
I'm pretty sure you know a decent amount about Knights. Now, let me ask you some personal questions about Knights.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
很好，很好...
我相信你对骑士的了解相当不错。现在，让我问你一些关于骑士的个人问题。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
What should you do when you run into a Novice asking for help in town?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
当你在城里遇到一位寻求帮助的初心者时，你应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Tell the Novice of a reasonable hunting area.
scripts.translation: 告诉初心者一个合适的狩猎区域。

scripts.text: Let the Novice fight while you take the damage.
scripts.translation: 让初心者战斗，而你承受伤害。

scripts.text: Give the Novice a bunch of Zeny and items.
scripts.translation: 给初心者大量的Zeny和物品。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Of course, even a Novice needs to learn how to be independent. Giving good guidance to Novices is one of the best things we can do.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
当然，即使是初心者也需要学会独立。给初心者正确的指导是我们能做的最好的事情之一。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You have the wrong idea. Do you really believe that is helping the Novice? Give a man a fish, he will eat for a day. Teach him to fish, he will eat for a lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你的想法错了。你真的认为那样是在帮助初心者吗？授人以鱼，不如授人以渔！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Do you really believe that this will truly help the poor Novice? It's generous but, they will not know the true value of zeny and items until they earn it themselves.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你真的认为这能真正帮助那位可怜的初心者吗？虽然很慷慨，但除非他们自己赚取，否则他们不会明白Zeny和物品的真正价值。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Alright...
Now, how should
you act within
a party?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
很好...
那么，在队伍中，
你应该如何行动？

scripts.text: Protect everyone in the front of the battle.
scripts.translation: 在战斗前线保护所有人。

scripts.text: Gather monsters and destroy them at once.
scripts.translation: 聚集魔物并一次性消灭它们。

scripts.text: Get as many items possible, at all cost.
scripts.translation: 不惜一切代价获取尽可能多的物品。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
That's it! Our strength and attacks are very important in a party. All Knights should engage in a battle with that mindset.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
就是这样！在队伍中，我们的力量和攻击非常重要。所有骑士都应该以这种心态投入战斗。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Are you crazy? Don't you realize the flaw in that kind of thinking? You can't control large mobs. What if they kill you? Who will protect the innocent?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你疯了吗？你没意识到这种想法的缺陷吗？你无法控制大量的魔物。如果它们杀了你，谁来保护无辜的人？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
I see your greed and we will have none of it here! It seems you do not truly care for others!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
我看到了你的贪婪，我们这里不容许这种行为！看来你并不真正关心他人！
滚开！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Lastly...
what's the most
important value
a Knight must have?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
最后...
骑士必须具备的
最重要的品质是什么？

scripts.text: Honor
scripts.translation: 荣誉

scripts.text: Wealth
scripts.translation: 财富

scripts.text: Status
scripts.translation: 地位

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Right, above all else, Knights must be honorable! We live and die for honor! Always keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
没错，最重要的是，骑士必须拥有荣誉！我们为了荣誉而生，为了荣誉而死！请时刻铭记这一点。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You're scum! You strive to become a Knight for personal wealth? Get lost! We will not accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你这人渣！为了个人财富而想成为骑士？滚开！我们骑士团不会接纳像你这样的人！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
So you're trying to become famous through the Chivalry? That's pathetic. We won't accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
所以你是想通过骑士团出名？真令人作呕。我们骑士团不会接纳像你这样的人！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Well then,
this is the
end of my test.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
那么，
我的测试到此结束。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
For your next
test, please go
see Sir Windsor.
He's very quiet,
but don't let that
get to you.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
下一个测试，
请去见温莎爵士。
他非常沉默，
但别被他的样子吓到。

scripts.translation: 我想参加转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Hey...
You already took my test, didn't you? You're done here. You should go visit Sir Windsor now...
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
嘿...
你已经参加过我的测试了，对吧？你在这里的测试结束了。现在你应该去见温莎爵士了...

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Hmmm...?
Alright.
It's just that
you had that
look on your
face.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
嗯...？
好吧。
只是你刚才
那个表情
让我有点在意。

[Sir Siracuse]
Well then,
go and see the
captain. We'll all
be there to evaluate
your performance.

去见船长吧。我们所有人

Protect.

保护。

outside.

...

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: 这是什么测试？

scripts.text: How do I take the test?
scripts.translation: 如何进行测试？

scripts.text: I'd like to leave.
scripts.translation: 我想离开。

scripts.text: No.

...
scripts.translation:

[Sir Windsor]

scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...Kill them all.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...把它们全部消灭。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]

全部通过。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
......3 minutes
for each stage.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
......每个阶段
限时3分钟。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
..........

[Sir Windsor]
...Go in the
waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...去候考室。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]

will begin.
scripts.translation:

if someone is testing.
scripts.translation:

你需要等待。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

...Go talk to
Amy Beatrice now.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...现在去找艾米夫人谈谈。

Oh...!
I wonder, why
have you come
to visit me?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哎呀...！
请问，您为什么

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww~
What a cute

Soooooo cute!
scripts.translation:

哇~

初心者呀！
太可爱了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Welcome to
the Prontera Chivalry~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
欢迎来到
普隆德拉骑士团~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Ooh, you're
a Swordsman...?
Did you come to
change jobs to
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哦，您是
剑士...？
是来转职
成为骑士的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Hmmm?
Why did you
come to Amy?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯？
您为什么
来找艾米呀？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您是骑士，正在寻找
莫洛克的队伍。
您打算怎么做呢？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Wow~
Now it's time for
everyone to decide
on your job change!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哇~
现在到了
大家决定
您转职的时候了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You're not having
trouble as a Knight,
are you? Well, I think
you're doing well~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
作为骑士，
您没有遇到
什么困难吧？
我觉得您做得
很好~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Of course~
You're a member of
the Prontera Chivalry~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
当然~
您是
普隆德拉骑士团的
成员~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Heh heh...
Are you interested
in becoming a Knight
later on? You'd be
a great Knight~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嘿嘿...
您有兴趣
以后成为骑士吗？
您会成为
很棒的骑士~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Remember, you're
going to be a Knight,
alright? Promise?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
记住，
您将成为骑士，
好吗？答应我？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
We're only Knights,
but hope you enjoy
your stay here.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我们只是骑士，
但希望您
在这里过得愉快。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
To apply, talk
to the captain
all the way over
there. Hee hee~
scripts.translation:

要申请的话，
去那边找
船长谈谈。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~
You applied to change jobs! Okay! You'll soon be a Knight with that kind of determination!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯~
您申请转职了！好的！
凭您这份提升斗志，
很快就能成为骑士了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But...
You have to go
to the other Knights
before talking to Amy.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
但是...
在找艾米之前，
您得先去找
其他骑士。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'd love to test
you from the beginning,
but I'm not allowed to.
Hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我很想
从头开始测试您，
但不允许这样做。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww~
Alright...
scripts.translation:

哎呀~

scripts.translation:

欢迎！
是时候接受

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]

a proud Lady Knight of the Prontera Chivalry. Amy's test will test your etiquette as a Knight~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我叫艾米·贝阿特丽丝，
是普隆德拉骑士团中

艾米的测试将检验
您作为骑士的礼仪~

scripts.translation:

我会讲一个故事，
当我提问时，
您请选择一个答案。
您的礼仪将根据

and answer as if you're
already a Knight, okay?

回答问题，好吗？

let's begin!

scripts.translation: 我想参加转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~?
Have you learned
what you did wrong
last time? If you
fail again, I'm going
to be mad!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯~？
您上次做错的地方
记住了吗？
如果再次失败，
我可要生气了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
So listen carefully
and answer as if you
are a Knight.
Well then,
let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
所以请仔细听，
并像一位骑士那样
回答问题。
那么，
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您是骑士，正在寻找
莫洛克的队伍。
您打算怎么做呢？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww...
Alright~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
哎呀...
好吧~

scripts.text:
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
您是一位骑士，
正在摩洛克寻找队伍。
您会怎么做？

scripts.text: Shout out that you are looking for a party.
scripts.translation: 大声呼喊您在寻找队伍。

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
scripts.translation: 打开聊天室并等待。

scripts.text: Look for people seeking Knights.
scripts.translation: 寻找正在招募骑士的人。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You have formed a party with equal leveled players. There's a Priest, a Wizard, a Hunter, an Assassin, and a Blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您与等级相近的玩家
组成了一个队伍。
队伍里有一位牧师、
一位巫师、一位猎人、
一位刺客和一位铁匠...

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
The six of you decide to go hunt and have decided to go to the Pyramids.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
你们六人决定去狩猎，
并决定前往金字塔。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You reach Level 4
of the Pyramids
with your party.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您和队伍到达了
金字塔的第4层。
您应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Check out the area and plan ahead.
scripts.translation: 观察周围并提前规划。

scripts.text: Gather monsters for your party members.
scripts.translation: 为队伍成员吸引魔物。

scripts.text: Lead the party slowly at the front.
scripts.translation: 在队伍前方缓慢引导。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But some rude players came with a group of monsters and disappeared! What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
但一些粗鲁的玩家
带着一群魔物
消失了！
您应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Keep the monsters from reaching the party.
scripts.translation: 阻止魔物接近队伍。

scripts.text: Defend while the party retreats.
scripts.translation: 掩护队伍撤退。

scripts.text: Run away on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation: 骑上大嘴鸟逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Luckily, you all lived through the crisis. But as you walk, you find a person, who is not in your party, collapsed on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
幸好大家都平安度过了危机。
但就在你们行走时，
发现一个不在队伍中的人
倒在地上。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
The person is asking politely for help. What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
那个人正在礼貌地请求帮助。
您应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Ask your party's Priest to help.
scripts.translation: 请队伍中的牧师帮忙。

scripts.text: Say you will help for Zeny.
scripts.translation: 表示愿意帮忙，但需要Zeny。

scripts.text: Ignore and move on.
scripts.translation: 无视并继续前行。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You must bid farewell to your party members because you must go somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您必须与队伍成员告别，
因为您要去别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But you find
a rare item during
the battle. What
should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
但在战斗中，
您发现了一个稀有物品。
您应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Give it to who deserves it the most.
scripts.translation: 把它给最需要的人。

scripts.text: Pretend like nothing happened and keep it.
scripts.translation: 假装什么都没发生，自己留着。

scripts.text: Decide with party who gets it.
scripts.translation: 与队伍商量谁得到它。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You end up with the item and you go to Prontera to sell it. There are many people with shops and chat rooms opened selling items.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
最终您得到了该物品，
并前往普隆德拉出售。
那里有许多人
开着商店和聊天室
在出售物品。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
What should you
do to sell your item?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您应该怎么做
来出售您的物品？

scripts.text: Shout out loud to everyone.
scripts.translation: 大声向所有人喊话。

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
scripts.translation: 打开聊天室并等待。

scripts.text: Inquire if there is anyone that is interested.
scripts.translation: 询问是否有人感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
While you are waiting,
someone comes and begs
for items and zeny.
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
在您等待时，
有人过来乞讨
物品和Zeny。
您怎么做？

scripts.text: Give them some Zeny and items.
scripts.translation: 给他们一些Zeny和物品。

scripts.text: Simply ignore them.
scripts.translation: 直接无视他们。

scripts.text: Give suggestions for a place to hunt.
scripts.translation: 给他们推荐一个打怪地点。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Now you decide to go to the Hidden Temple by yourself. You happily ride on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
现在您决定独自前往隐藏神殿。
您开心地骑在大嘴鸟上。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But you run into
someone that is lost.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
但您遇到了一个迷路的人。
您该怎么办？

scripts.text: Tell the person how to reach the exit.
scripts.translation: 告诉对方如何到达出口。

scripts.text: Lead the person to the exit.
scripts.translation: 带对方去出口。

scripts.text: Give a Butterfly Wing.
scripts.translation: 给对方一个蝴蝶翅膀。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You've been hunting for a while, and now you're low on HP!
It's red now, which is very dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您已经打怪一段时间了，现在HP很低！
HP显示为红色，这非常危险。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Ah, then a Priest
happens to walk by.
How would you ask
the Priest for a Heal?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
啊，这时一位牧师恰好路过。
您会如何向牧师请求治愈术？

scripts.text: Would it be possible to get a heal please?
scripts.translation: 请问可以麻烦您治疗一下吗？

scripts.text: Can I have a heal?
scripts.translation: 能给我治疗一下吗？

scripts.text: Heal plz!!
scripts.translation: 快治疗我！！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are now very
exhausted and it's time
to go back to town.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您现在非常疲惫，是时候回城镇了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You then find
a rare item on
the street.
What should
you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
然后您在街上发现了一个稀有物品。
您该怎么办？

scripts.text: Pick it up and keep it.
scripts.translation: 捡起来据为己有。

scripts.text: Ask around to find the owner.
scripts.translation: 四处打听寻找失主。

scripts.text: Simply walk by.
scripts.translation: 直接走开。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Okay,
that was the
end of my test!
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
好了，
我的测试到此结束！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Well done, that kind of mentality is needed for a Knight! For your next test, visit Sir Edmond, please~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
做得好，这种心态正是一位骑士所需要的！对于您的下一个测试，请去拜访埃德蒙爵士~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Well, it wasn't perfect,
but I think you know enough
about etiquette to be
a fine Knight.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯，虽然并不完美，
但我认为您已经具备了足够的礼仪，
可以成为一名优秀的骑士了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm...
To be honest, I don't think your attitude is good enough to be a Knight quite yet.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
嗯...
说实话，我觉得您的态度还不足以成为一名骑士。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'll have nice comments about you for the captain. Do well on the tests you have left, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
我会向船长说些关于您的好话。在剩下的测试中好好表现，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Now, it's time for you to go to Sir Edmond for your next test. Do well on the rest of your tests. You better promise~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
现在，是时候去埃德蒙爵士那里进行下一个测试了。在剩下的测试中好好表现。您最好答应我~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
If you really act like that, everyone will think Knights are rude! Think about how you answered my questions and come again later.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
如果您真的那样做，大家都会觉得骑士很没礼貌！想想您是如何回答我的问题的，稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
If you want,
I'll let you
retake the test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
如果您愿意，
我可以让您
重新参加测试，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You have to go to
Sir Edmond for your
next test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您必须去埃德蒙爵士那里
进行下一个测试，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Let's go talk to our
captain. Don't worry
too much. It should
be okay.
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
让我们去和船长谈谈吧。
别太担心。
应该没问题的。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You still have
other tests to take.
Hurry and finish~
scripts.translation:
[艾米夫人]
您还有其他测试要参加。
快去完成吧~

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Think of your
mind as if it were
flowing water.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
试着将您的心
想象成流动的水。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Trees with deep roots don't sway with the wind. The fact that powerful skills must be built on strong basics is immutable...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
根深叶茂的树木不会随风摇摆。强大的技能必须建立在坚实的基础之上，这是不变的真理...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Everything in this world exists in harmony. Living without disrupting this harmony is the right way to live...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
世间万物和谐共存。不破坏这种和谐地生活，才是正确的生存之道...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Those with ominous thoughts will only dream such dreams. It's better to have no dreams at all than to have dreams of sadness and despair.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
心怀不祥之人只会做那样的梦。与其做悲伤绝望的梦，不如不做梦。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
What is it...
Wandering Swordman?
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
有什么事吗...
流浪的剑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
What is it...
Wandering Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
有什么事吗...
流浪的剑士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
I have seen your character for myself. It is now time for you to take the last test. Go and speak
to Sir Gray...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
我已经亲自考察过您的品行了。现在是时候进行最后的测试了。去和格雷爵士对话吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Go and speak
to our captain.
The time has come
for all of us to
evaluate your
performance.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
去和我们的船长对话吧。
是时候让我们所有人
来评估您的表现了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Flowing water
avoids obstacles,
going on its way...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
流动的水
会避开障碍，
继续前行...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Knights must be
able to pass things,
like calm water, in
any situation.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
骑士必须像平静的水流一样，
在任何情况下都能
从容应对。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Your future
can even be
decided now...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
您的未来
甚至可以在现在
就决定下来...

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
A seed must first be nestled
in the earth before the seed may sprout. Then, the sprout must grow leaves before its buds blossom into flowers...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
种子必须先在泥土中安顿下来才能发芽。然后，嫩芽必须长出叶子，花蕾才能绽放成花朵...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
If not...
The flower will
be incomplete.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
否则...
花朵将
无法完美绽放。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Go to the others
first, so that you
may find your path...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
先去见其他人吧，
这样您才能
找到自己的道路...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life that you
want will soon be
before your eyes.
Everything will
come in perfect
order.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
您想要的生活
很快就会
呈现在您眼前。
一切都会
井然有序。

scripts.text: Lady Amy sent me.
scripts.translation: 艾米夫人派我来的。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
It is now time to take my test. Please do your best, as you have done on the other tests.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
现在该进行我的测试了。请像在其他测试中那样，全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
My name is
Edmond Groster.
I am a member of
the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
我的名字是
埃德蒙·格罗斯特。
我是普隆德拉骑士团的成员。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Knights are in the position for others to follow. Therefore, you must modestly think about the world's order and have the personality to fit the role you will play.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
骑士处于受人追随的位置。因此，您必须谦逊地思考世界的秩序，并具备符合您即将扮演的角色的人格。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You must not make careless decisions. Your will should bend as the reeds or be as firm as stone when the situation calls for it.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
您不能做出草率的决定。您的意志应当像芦苇一样随势而弯，或在局势需要时像石头一样坚定。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You must not kill monsters without reason and not take joy in doing so. Take this time to quietly think about this on your own...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
您不能无缘无故地杀害魔物，也不能以此为乐。请利用这段时间独自静静思考一下...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Then, we shall
begin the test.
Keep in mind
the quality of
reverence.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
那么，
我们开始测试吧。
请记住
敬畏之心。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life you want
will soon be before
your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
您想要的生活
很快就会
呈现在您眼前。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不是故意的...

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You were too careless in the last test. A Knight's sword exists to protect others, not to torment weaker monsters.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
您在上一轮测试中太粗心了。骑士的剑是用来保护他人的，而不是用来折磨较弱的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
In a world where everything exists in harmony, you can't have humans continuously destroying without purpose. This principle applies to the real world, not to this test alone.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
在一个万物和谐共存的世界里，人类不能无休止地无目的破坏。这一原则适用于现实世界，而不仅仅局限于这次测试。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The test
shall begin.
Show me your
patience...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
测试
即将开始。
向我展示
您的耐心...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life that you
want will soon be
before your eyes.
Everything will
come in perfect
order.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
您想要的生活
很快就会
呈现在您眼前。
一切都会
井然有序。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The glint of light
that shines off this blade cannot be put into words. This is the weapon every Knight must have.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
这把剑上闪烁的光芒无法用言语形容。这是每位骑士都必须拥有的武器。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Believe it
or not, I was
once a Novice
as well.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
信不信由你，
我曾经也是一名
初心者。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Young one,
use your time
wisely.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
年轻人，
请善用你的时间。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh...
A young Swordman.
Yes, what can
I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦...
一位年轻的剑士。
是的，有什么
我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, you again.
What brings you
to me?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，又是你。
这次有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
To become stronger, you say?
Yes, Knights are indeed strong.
But why gain strength?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[Sir Gray]
你想变得更强，是吗？
是的，骑士确实很强。
但为什么要追求力量呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[Sir Gray]
啊，为了帮助你的公会，或者甚至是你的队伍。我们英明仁慈的国王特里斯特姆三世曾赐予我们这句至理名言...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
Satisfaction, you say.
It seems like you are
already a fine Swordman.
Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[Sir Gray]
满足感，是吗。
看来你已经是一名优秀的剑士了。
有什么特别的原因让你想成为骑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
I understand your thoughts,
but there are those who wish to
become Knights without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[Sir Gray]
我理解你的想法，
但有些人想成为骑士时
并没有经过深思熟虑。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I told you
to go to
the captain.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我让你去找船长了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh...
A young Swordman.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦...
一位年轻的剑士。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Yes...
^3355FFClaymore^000000!
Every Knight
would want one!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
是的...
^3355FF双手剑^000000！
每位骑士
都会想要一把！

scripts.text: About ^3355FFClaymore^000000
Buy Claymore
scripts.translation: 购买双手剑

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Claymore, one of the best among the famous swords you can attain in Rune-Midgarts' Prontera!! Its value is priceless when considered by a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
双手剑，是卢恩·米德加兹的普隆德拉中你能获得的著名剑类武器中最好的之一！！对于骑士来说，它的价值是无价的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Now, the Prontera Chivalry is making these fabulous Claymores. For Knights, they are only ^3355FF74,000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
现在，普隆德拉骑士团正在制造这些精美的双手剑。对于骑士来说，价格仅为^3355FF74,000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
But not only that, you need
1 ^3355FFSteel^000000 because of the Claymore's characteristics. If you like, I can create one for you. For the honor of the Prontera Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
不仅如此，由于双手剑的特性，你还需要1个^3355FF钢铁^000000。如果你愿意，我可以为你打造一把。为了普隆德拉骑士团的荣誉！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no...
It seems that you are carrying too many things. You don't have enough space for a heavy Claymore in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哎呀...
看来你携带的东西太多了。你的物品栏没有足够的空间放一把沉重的手剑。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Why don't you
go and organize
your items first.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
你为什么不先去整理一下你的物品呢。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
You are ready!
You must know the
true value of
a Claymore!
I shall make
it right now!!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
你准备好了！
你肯定知道
双手剑的
真正价值！
我现在就
为你打造！！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The basics of
making the Claymore
is easy. Watch~!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
打造双手剑的
基础很简单。看好了~！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Stir Stir*^000000
^3355FF*Ooncha Ooncha*^000000

[Sir Gray]
Okay, it's ready!
Every Knight's pride:
a fine ^3355FFClaymore^000000.
You attained a reliable item.
It'll be a good companion on your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
好了，完成了！
每位骑士的骄傲：
一把精美的^3355FF双手剑^000000。
你获得了一件可靠的装备。
它将成为你冒险旅途中的好伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I realize you may really want a Claymore, but I can't make it without the materials.
^3355FF74,000 zeny^000000 and ^3355FF1 Steel!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我知道你可能非常想要一把双手剑，但没有材料我无法打造。
^3355FF74,000 Zeny^000000和^3355FF1个钢铁！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Come back when
you have everything
ready. I shall be
waiting...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
等你准备好所有东西
再回来吧。我会
在这里等待...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Any Knight should be able to wield a Claymore as if it were an extension of their body. I used to look forward to brandishing my Claymore in battle...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
任何骑士都应该能够像使用身体延伸一样挥舞双手剑。我曾经很期待在战斗中挥舞我的双手剑...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I never really planned to become a Knight, but I did decide to become a strong person. Somehow, along my journeys, I ended up joining the Prontera Chivalry. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我从未真正计划过成为骑士，但我确实决定要成为一个强大的人。不知怎的，在旅途中，我加入了普隆德拉骑士团。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
Young one,
use your time
wisely.
scripts.translation:
年轻人，
请善用你的时间。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
No point in
harboring regret
once time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
时间一旦过去，
后悔是没有意义的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
No point in
harboring regret
once time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
时间一旦过去，
后悔是没有意义的。

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Hoho, I see.
So you took
everyone else's
test?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
呵呵，我明白了。
看来你已经
通过了其他人的
测试？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then shall
we begin mine?
It's not really
a test though.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么，
我们开始我的
测试吧？
不过，这其实
算不上测试。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Let's talk
casually,
shall we?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我们随便
聊聊，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
First...
Why did you
decide to become
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
首先...
你为什么要
决定成为
骑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
保重！

scripts.text: I've been thinking a lot.
scripts.translation: 我思考了很多。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Is that so...
I wonder if you
truly have...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
是吗...
我想知道你是否
真的拥有...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then...
Like last time,
I will ask again...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么...
像上次一样，
我再问一次...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
First...
Why did you
decide to become
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
首先...
你为什么要
决定成为
骑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
Health is
every man's
treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
保重！
健康是每个人
的财富！

scripts.text: To become stronger...
scripts.translation: 为了变得更强...

scripts.text: To help my guild...
scripts.translation: 为了帮助我的公会...

scripts.text: Because I'm unsatisfied with myself right now...
scripts.translation: 因为我不满现在的自己...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
To become stronger, you say?
Yes, Knights are indeed strong.
But why gain strength?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
为了变得更强，是吗？
是的，骑士确实强大。
但为什么要追求力量？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Is it to show off to others? To attain fame? Or do you have a diferent reason? What do you think is so good about gaining strength as a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
是为了向他人炫耀？为了获得名声？还是你有其他原因？你认为作为骑士获得力量有什么好的地方？

scripts.text: Gain wealth and fame.
scripts.translation: 获得财富和名声。

scripts.text: I can protect myself.
scripts.translation: 我可以保护自己。

scripts.text: I can protect others.
scripts.translation: 我可以保护他人。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Of course, wealth and fame have their place in the world. But we as Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
当然，财富和名声在世间有其位置。但我们作为骑士，必须为了更高的美德而活。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Good thinking. You must first be able to protect yourself in order to protect others. To this end, you must constantly train, and never give in to laziness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
想法很好。首先你必须能够保护自己，才能保护他人。为此，你必须不断训练，绝不能向懒惰屈服。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，真是个好主意。骑士的力量必须用来保护弱者，捍卫正义。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
令人遗憾的是，有些骑士忘记了骑士道的基本准则，令我们蒙羞...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，为了帮助你的公会，或者甚至你的队伍。我们睿智而仁慈的国王特里斯特姆三世曾赐予我们这样的箴言...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
^8B7500Beyond the calm river, lies a dangerous waterfall. Therefore, you must always be prepared for everything...^000000
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
^8B7500平静的河流之下，往往隐藏着危险的瀑布。因此，你必须时刻为一切做好准备...^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
So how do you
think you can
help your guild?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么，你认为
自己该如何
帮助你的公会呢？

scripts.text: My guild needs me.
scripts.translation: 我的公会需要我。

scripts.text: I can help gather funds for my guild.
scripts.translation: 我可以为公会筹集资金。

scripts.text: I can protect my guild members.
scripts.translation: 我可以保护公会的成员。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Anyone, anywhere in this world,
has a place where they are needed. Never neglect someone in need, even if he is not a guild member.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
在这个世界上，任何人、任何地方，都有需要你的地方。即使对方不是公会成员，也不要忽视那些需要帮助的人。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Of course wealth is important.
But we Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
当然，财富很重要。
但我们骑士必须为了更高的美德而活。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，真是个好主意。骑士的力量必须用来保护弱者，捍卫正义。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
令人遗憾的是，有些骑士忘记了骑士道的基本准则，令我们蒙羞...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Satisfaction, you say.
It seems like you are
already a fine Swordman.
Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
满足感，是吗。
看来你已经是一名优秀的剑士了。
有什么特别的原因让你想成为骑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I don't know about
Swordmen, but Knights do not allow self-indulgence. There are those so obsessed with gaining strength that they cannot control themselves.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我不知道剑士们怎么想，但骑士绝不允许放纵自我。有些人沉迷于追求力量，以至于无法控制自己。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
So...
What part of yourself
are you not satisfied
with right now?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么...
你目前对自己
哪方面最不满意？

scripts.text: Skills.
scripts.translation: 技能

scripts.text: Goal.
scripts.translation: 目标

scripts.text: Appearance.
scripts.translation: 外表

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Skill is something you gain with experience as a Knight. It cannot be your highest goal. Otherwise, you'll never be satisfied as a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
技能是随着骑士的经验积累而获得的。它不能成为你最高的目标。否则，你作为骑士永远不会感到满足。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I see...
Always having a goal is very important. You may be full of ideas upon becoming a Knight, but that may change with time.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我明白了...
始终拥有目标是非常重要的。成为骑士时你可能充满想法，但随着时间的推移，这些想法可能会改变。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no...
What you see isn't what really counts. A Swordman may be stronger than a Knight, and even Knight may grow weak if he becomes lazy.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
噢不...
外表并不重要。剑士可能比骑士更强，而骑士如果变得懒惰，也会变得虚弱。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I understand your thoughts,
but there are those who wish to
become Knights without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我理解你的想法，
但有些人想成为骑士，
却从不思考。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Those are the ones who instigate problems and shame the honor of Knights, bringing irreversible results.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
正是这些人挑起事端，玷污了骑士的荣誉，并带来不可挽回的后果。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The same goes for you as well. Once you become a Knight, you can never become a Swordman again. The duties and responsibilities of a Knight will always be with you.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
对你也是如此。一旦成为骑士，你就再也无法变回剑士了。骑士的职责与责任将永远伴随你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you become a Knight right away, what are you going to do first?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
如果你立刻成为骑士，你打算先做什么？

scripts.text: I am going to go straight to battle.
scripts.translation: 我要直接投入战斗。

scripts.text: There are those waiting for me.
scripts.translation: 有人正在等我。

scripts.text: I will learn more about Knights.
scripts.translation: 我想更多地了解骑士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Battle...?
And then?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
战斗...？
然后呢？

scripts.text: I will grow within a short period of time.
scripts.translation: 我想在短时间内成长。

scripts.text: I would like to test my ability as a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想测试自己作为骑士的能力。

scripts.text: I would like to go to more challenging places.
scripts.translation: 我想去更具挑战性的地方。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't be in too much of a hurry to become strong. Even if you become
a Knight, you are still yourself.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
不要急于变强。即使成为骑士，你依然是你自己。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Testing yourself is a good thing. It's okay to be happy about how you change, but don't forget about the true qualities of being a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
测试自己是一件好事。为自身的改变感到高兴也没关系，但别忘了骑士应有的真正品质。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Even if you become a Knight, you are not changing your inner self. No need to overwork yourself.
Relax and take things step by step.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
即使成为骑士，你的内心也不会改变。不必过度劳累。
放松身心，循序渐进。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Who is
waiting for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
谁在
等你？

scripts.text: My friends.
scripts.translation: 我的朋友们。

scripts.text: My Guild members.
scripts.translation: 我的公会成员。

scripts.text: My Lover.
scripts.translation: 我的恋人。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I see, they would share in the joy of your achievements. Don't ever lose your kind heart, and always give help to your friends.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我明白了，他们会与你分享成就的喜悦。永远不要失去你的宅心仁厚，并总是帮助你的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Those who would share in your happiness and hardship. As a Knight, you must always protect them.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那些与你同甘共苦的人。作为骑士，你必须永远保护他们。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh, youth!
Becoming a Knight
for your beloved!
Always protect {0}...
Even at the sacrifice
of your own life!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
噢，年轻人！
为了爱人
成为骑士！
永远保护{0}...
即使牺牲
自己的生命！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Also...
Love them forever.
Sincere affection
is hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
还有...
永远爱他们。
真挚的情感
难以寻觅。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Good attitude...
What do you plan
on learning?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
态度不错...
你打算
学习什么？

scripts.text: Comfortable places for Knights to go...
scripts.translation: 骑士们常去的舒适场所...

scripts.text: The different paths of a Knight...
scripts.translation: 骑士的不同道路...

scripts.text: Ways to get more money as a Knight...
scripts.translation: 骑士如何赚取更多金钱...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
There are many places that are comfortable or uncomfortable in this world. However Knights must
be able to survive anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
这个世界上有很多舒适或不舒适的地方。然而，骑士必须能够在任何地方生存。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
There are many similar Knights outside in the world. Think of them as your seniors and ask many questions.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
外面有很多和你相似的骑士。把他们当作前辈，多向他们请教。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no. Do you hold wealth as a priority of being a Knight? We're not meant to be that way. Come again when you have thought
more about it...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
噢，不。你把财富当作骑士的首要目标吗？我们不该是这样的。等你想清楚后再来吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no, we've been
talking too much...
I apologize for
keeping you here
for so long.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
噢，不，我们聊得太多了...
抱歉让你在这里待了这么久。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed talking with you. You remind me of myself as a young recruit. Shall we talk to the captain and decide on your
job change?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你聊天很愉快。你让我想起了年轻时的自己。我们要不要去找船长，决定你的转职？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't worry too
much, I have a very
high opinion of you.
Now, go~
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
别太担心，我对你的评价很高。
现在，去吧~

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed speaking with you. You can think about the principles of Knighthood more once you become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你交谈很愉快。等你成为骑士后，可以再多思考一下骑士的道义。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then, shall we go to the captain and decide on your job change? Don't worry too much. You are good enough to be a Knight!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么，我们要不要去找船长，决定你的转职？别太担心。你完全有资格成为骑士！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed talking with you. Although, there were some
things that bothered me...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你聊天很愉快。不过，有些让我感到困扰的地方...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
You should go
to the captain
so we can decide
on your job change.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
你应该去找船长，
以便我们决定你的转职。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't worry too much, coming to take my test means the others have acknowledged you as well.
Go now...!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
别太担心，来接受我的测试，说明其他人也认可你了。
现在去吧...！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Conversing
with young ones
is always enjoyable...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和年轻人交谈
总是令人愉快的...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
But it seems as though your dream is elsewhere, or that your focus is hazy. Spend more time as a Swordman, and come back
to me later.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
但看起来你的梦想在别处，或者你的心思有些恍惚。作为剑士再磨练一段时间，之后再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you truly wish to become a Knight, you must change your outlook first. Then, we shall see.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
如果你真的想成为骑士，必须先改变你的观念。然后，我们再看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Everyone will
carefully make
their decision,
so go now!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
每个人都会
仔细做出决定，
现在去吧！

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职测试。

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Hoho~
There are many
other younger
Knights in here.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
呵呵~
这里还有很多
年轻的骑士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you talk
to all of them,
I may review
you as well.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
如果你和他们
都谈谈，
我也许会重新
评估你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
Health is
every man's
treasure!
scripts.translation:
